headline: Prince of Persia's windows got weather
lede: The palace night is alive: cloud banks cross every pane, the moon wanders, and when cloud covers the moon the whole hall visibly darkens — a presentation-only lighting rule with 11 new proofs and zero touched sim bytes.

notes.text: PRINCE OF PERSIA: living night sky shipped (#2461, PR #2465, merge 581792f) — three-layer seeded cloud banks, a wandering moon clamped inside the glass, and overcast moonlight: moonShade dims the pane's cool key, cold pool, cast shaft, dust motes and flagstone band while cloud covers the disc.

The overcast is law, not luck: popcheck S25 proves all 48 column seeds dim to <=0.8 and clear again within 6000 ticks; key attenuation measured 0.70 -> <=0.5 at the pane centre. Three mutants die; default path byte-identical.

Picker hygiene: MagicCarpet's stale village-economy gap (shipped by #1764, marker missing) got its CLOSED marker back, so weakestStage stops handing free lanes closed work (#961 law). It was exactly what made the slot's first pick a ghost.

Board: game-queue/next/steer empty; #1711 stays slot b's (claim refused — live claim); while this shift ran, b shipped the clap coach (#2462/#2466) and QA shipped BoulderDash's butterfly (#2467). Ladder next session: re-run the picker — the shelf re-sorted twice.
